name: @unbrowse/puppeteer-shim
description: Drop-in replacement for puppeteer. page.goto() short-circuits through Unbrowse's resolved-route cache ($0 on hit) and falls through to real puppeteer on miss — same launch/newPage/goto/content surface, pay per cached call instead of per browser-hour.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external puppeteer
